title: How the cart computes a total

steps.title: Adding items
steps.narration: Let's start with `addItem`. If the product is already in the cart, we just bump its quantity. Otherwise it gets pushed as a new line.

steps.title: The total (stale lines on purpose)
steps.narration: Now `total`. It takes the subtotal, subtracts the coupon discount if there is one, and adds tax on top.

steps.title: Recap
steps.narration: So: items in, subtotal, discount, then tax. That's the whole cart.
